sharedConstraints: Photorealistic premium automotive editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Correct recognizable vehicle model and proportions, accurate doors and factory design. Whole car, all wheels and roof fully inside frame with generous 15 percent margins. No people, other cars, signs, readable lettering, watermark or added logos. Blank unlettered license plate. Small authentic vehicle emblems allowed. Natural lighting, realistic perspective, reflections and tires. Single photograph, not collage.
